definitions.short: Debir , the name of an Amoritish king and of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H1688. Debir II. דְּבִיר 1. proper name, masculine king of Eglon Josh 10:3 . 2. proper name, of a location a. דְּבִ֫רָה with ָ ה locative, northern border Judah Josh 15:7 ( westward Hup Psa 28:2 ). b. לִדְבִר town of the Gadites Josh 13:26 , perhaps Lôdebâr 2Sam 9:4 see דְבָר לֹא Di MV. c. דְּבִיר Judg 1:11 (twice in verse); 1Chr 6:43 , דְּבִרָה Josh 10:38-39 , elsewhere דְּבִר 15:15 +, a royal city of Canaanites anciently called סֵפֶר קִרְיַת 15:15 ; Judg 1:11 , סַנָּה קִרְיַת Josh 15:49 ; on the mountains of Judah, in region of Hebron 11:21 ; 15:49 , assigned to the Aaronite priests 21:15 as a city of refuge 1Chr 6:43 ; modern Dhoherîye , 5 hours southwest from Hebron, according to Kn, so Survey iii. 402 ; other conjectures in Di Josh 10:39 Ri HWB 265 .
